d:
The parents discover that Tapu Sena has lied about going to extra classes. To make matters worse, the kids collected money from home under the guise of study supplies—including Daya giving Tapu ₹1,000 without asking Jethalal, leading Jethalal to sarcastically call her "Rani Victoria.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
